source.frame_script_order: source timer fire is after state at fight_tick N; next source state at N+1 is frame1 with retained p2 action/hstm/hits; frame2 at N+2 clears them
source.source_invariant: nextfight writes rounds/focus, goto p1/p2 stand, chushi, fall/touch/sw, ready. chushi writes health and placement/facing. It does not write actor action, hits, or hstm.
source.place_object_move: No new fighter PlaceObject on round reset; existing fighter instances are goto targets. New frame callbacks obey next-frame dispatch.
source.leave_label: goto stand with play=true; frame1 state is observed before frame1 callback settlement, frame2 follows.
source.same_input_evidence: source-timer-hp1-r01, source-timer-kill700-r01, byakuya-timer700-r01; all raw timer fire events occur after same-fight-tick state sequence and before next frame1 state.

runtime_gap.behavior: _ko_service goto calls actor.start_action(label) for non-AI timeline actors; start_action immediately changes action and queues frame1, so the next root snapshot loses source-retained action/hstm/hits.
runtime_gap.observed: After a generic external-tape callback, frame/position/timer phase can match; remaining strict differences are exactly p2 action/hstm/hits at first post-reset snapshot unless the runner writes fields (which is rejected).
runtime_gap.proposed_rule: Introduce a source-goto path for controller timeline goto that changes the playhead/playing state and queues the frame script without synthesizing a fighter action transition or clearing source state. Preserve existing action/hits/hstm until the placed frame's next source callback updates them. Validate against all three timer fixtures and existing KO regressions.

runner_policy: The temporary field-rewrite runner is diagnostic_not_accepted and must not be promoted.
